mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drift_event (metric, current_value, previous_value, threshold, detail, create_time) VALUES (#{metric}, #{currentValue}, #{previousValue}, #{threshold}, #{detail}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, metric, current_value, previous_value, threshold, detail, create_time FROM drift_event ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
